title: Embodied Scale Pleasure Bits
principle: Make magnitude legible through changing relationships between body, space, action, and environmental response.

bits.name: THRESHOLD TEST
bits.response: a familiar doorway becomes a recurring measure of scale
bits.memory: the doorway preserves every previous baseline

bits.name: FURNITURE DRIFT
bits.response: furniture is progressively repositioned or replaced

bits.name: FLOOR REPLY
bits.response: materials communicate load through sound, vibration, or visible response
bits.memory: the building develops a reputation for particular footsteps

bits.name: CAMERA COMPRESSION
bits.response: the visual field becomes increasingly body-dominated
bits.memory: older views remain available as scale snapshots

bits.name: OLD BASELINE ROOM
bits.response: the room reveals the magnitude of the body's change
bits.memory: the room becomes an artifact of the former state

bits.name: ADAPTIVE ARCHITECTURE
bits.response: the environment quietly changes its clearances and circulation
bits.memory: adaptation becomes part of world canon

bits.name: SCALE WITNESS
bits.response: an unchanged person or object supplies a stable reference

bits.name: RETURN VISIT
bits.memory: the world records visits as cumulative state

bits.name: SHADOW MEASURE
bits.memory: lighting conditions become part of the scale record

bits.name: DISTANCE COLLAPSE
bits.memory: navigation history records the changed route

generation_rule: Every major scale event should propagate into at least three relational variables and one persistent memory.
